templates.why_chosen: An architecture pipeline, a symbol-definition notation key, and a colour-coded worked example sit side by side as three unlike kinds with no visible borders between them, a violation of the clear-gutter rule the template requires.
templates.what_to_learn: Leave an explicit 8-12pt gutter (or a thin frame) between an architecture panel, a notation key, and a worked example even when they logically belong together, since merging three conceptually different sub-panels with no visible border, a listed weakness here, makes the figure read as one crowded panel instead of three legible ones.
